task.title: Configuring an Automated Outage Alert Threshold
task.shortdesc: Set custom load and voltage thresholds to trigger automated notifications in the Grid Operations Console.

ul.li: You must have Grid Administrator or Operations Engineer permissions.
The target substation telemetry feed must be active and verified.

context.p: Use this procedure to configure early-warning alerts when feeder load approaches critical capacity.

step.cmd: Log in to the Grid Operations Console and navigate to MonitoringAlert Rules.
Select the target Substation ID and choose Transformer Load (%) as the metric.
Enter 85 in the Warning Threshold field and 95 in the Critical Threshold field.
Select the notification channel (Email, SMS, or Webhook) and click Save Rule.
step.stepresult: The alert rule appears in the active rules table with a status of Enabled.

result.p: The system now monitors the selected substation and dispatches automated alerts whenever load values exceed the configured thresholds.
